About
Why Choose Us
First Class Care
The Fairy Dogmother, LLC offers a friendly and relaxed atmosphere for your four legged child to be pampered. We mostly do appointments that allow one-on-one attention, where we concentrate on your dog from beginning to end. Your dog can be picked up immediately upon finishing. Our cottages allow for a cage-free atmosphere with plenty of space to relax for any size dog. Giant breeds welcome! We work as a team. Often times multiple people will work on your dog during its appointment to ensure comfort and timely grooms.
Our Education
We are always continuing our education and attend grooming shows and expos around the US! We keep up with trends and are willing to work with any owner on more creative cuts and styles. Pet safe hair color is available by request!
10+ Years in Business
Our Team
Arielle Derice Poland
Started Grooming in 2013
Founded The Fairy Dogmother, LLC in 2014
Lives in Falmouth with her three wonderful children and husband
Jenn Chiu
Started grooming in 2016
Joined the Fairy Dogmother Team in 2019
My passion for caring for dogs started at a young age, once graduating high school i knew dog grooming was going to be the perfect career for me!
Lives in Brunswick with her husband, 6 month old daughter, and 3 beloved pets Kimber (Husky mix) Cheif (German Shepard) and Nova (Standard Poodle)
Jenn holds many certifications including but not limited to :
Professional Pet Grooming Certification 2017
Pet CPR/First Aid Certification
Grooming the difficult dog 101
Brachycephalic breed safety
Super styling the poodle
Jenn has taken her career to the next level by attending dog grooming competitions throughout the US coming out with a top 3 award for her first competition as well as Best in Show First Timer at Intergroom Grooming Exposition in New Jersey
